title: Istituto Borgo
description: Istituto Comprensivo di Borgo San Giuseppe (CN) is a state comprehensive school (codice meccanografico CNIC847004) based in the Oltregesso area of Cuneo and covering the nearby town of Castelletto Stura. It runs 11 sites: 3 preschools (infanzia), 6 primary schools, and 2 lower-secondary schools (medie). The head of school is Lorenzo Busciglio.
